cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Hand Over the Proof
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender information, evidence, a key, or access that would let you proceed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Give me the actual note, not your description.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can read it to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. I want the words that don't get your emphasis.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then show me the one line you're using to decide for me.
